text: Two alphabets in unknown orders, one for the message and one for the carved letters. At each key length 1-26, exact arithmetic on the 24 known letters decides whether any pair of orders fits, on K4 and 100 scrambled copies.
The code failed after 0.9 seconds, while writing out the first pair of alphabets it found: a number stood where a letter was expected. No length was recorded.
0122 retried the same code a few seconds later and failed on the same line. 0123 fixed it and ran the test in full.
